messages:
Aisha (partnerships): Quick sync 1: we need final assets and signoff for the new cloud marketplace catalog entry. Items: press embargo time, partner quote, hero copy, marketplace screenshots, and lead form wiring. Tagging @Tom @Priya @Diego @Maya @Olga.
Tom (marketing): Recommend embargo Wed PM so partners have morning to approve. That lets us queue blog + socials Thu.
Priya (PR): Wed PM works if legal + partners sign off by Wed noon. Need partner PR contact and a 1-2 sentence quote.
Aisha (partnerships): GCP & Azure confirmed logos + quote by Tue EOD. AWS pending.
Diego (design): I'll mock hero; need SVG + 2x PNG logos. If missing, will use placeholders.
Maya (legal): Send quote drafts here. Partners usually want a chance to edit 1 turnaround ~24h. Also need logo usage confirmation.
Luca (product): Landing page must list model variants, p95 latency, and CTAs: "Try Hosted API" and "Request Dedicated". I'll paste exact numbers later.
Olga (eng-infra): For marketplace: need 1440x900 screenshot and 300x250 thumbnail. I can capture Wed afternoon once UI strings are final.
Aisha (partnerships): Proposed timeline:
- Tue AM: assets in
- Tue PM: design + marketing draft
- Wed AM: legal review
- Wed PM: partner approval + embargo send
- Thu 12:00 PT: publish
Tom (marketing): I'll draft blog skeleton and hero blurb (30-40 words). Need a 120-word partner quote.
Diego (design): Figma link uploading: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/marketplace-launch (frame: hero/v1). @Tom flag copy there.
Priya (PR): Drafting press release now, will share doc link. Add partner PR contacts so I can loop them.
Maya (legal): If using numbers, label as 'internal benchmark' and get partner approval before publish.
Aisha (partnerships): We have internal bench: median p95 latency down ~18% on Dedicated for 2k tokens. We'll mark as internal.
Tom (marketing): UTMs: I'll post params in #marketing in 30m. Need them by Thu AM to wire paid.
Luca (product): I'll wire lead form to webhook and append UTMs once provided.
Olga (eng-infra): Will post screenshots Wed PM.
Priya (PR): 1 draft press doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/PR-DRAFT (sharing now).
Aisha (partnerships): Quick ask: 30m partner briefing Tue 10:00 PT to confirm logos & quotes. Can everyone attend?
Tom (marketing): Yes.
Priya (PR): Yes.
Diego (design): On calendar.
Maya (legal): I'll try to join; will assign backup if needed.
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: Tue 10:00 PT 1 Partner assets check-in.
Aisha (partnerships): Final checklist before embargo: logos & quotes, legal approval, hero + screenshots, blog + press draft, marketplace listing, UTMs + form wiring. Please mark done in thread.
Priya (PR): 1 press draft ready (will update after Tue call).
Tom (marketing): 1 UTMs posted.
Diego (design): 1 hero v1 uploaded.
Maya (legal): Will mark after Wed AM review.
Olga (eng-infra): Will post screenshots Wed PM.
Aisha (partnerships): Thanks all, will update after Tue call. End thread. :rocket:
